---
title: "Data integrity report: Zenodo offloading"
output: html_document
params:
  package: "curatedOvarianData"
  upload_dir: "../../../curatedOvarianData-zenodo-upload"
---

<!-- Verifies the Zenodo data offloading, run manually from inst/scripts/
     of a package checkout (not built with the package vignettes):

     1. every xz re-serialized object uploaded to Zenodo is identical to
        the object shipped in the last pre-refactor package version
        (git tag pre-zenodo-refactor);
     2. the md5 checksums in inst/extdata/zenodo-manifest.csv match both
        the local upload files and the checksums Zenodo reports;
     3. one real download through the getter works and hits the cache on
        the second call.

     Because the manifest md5s equal the md5s of byte-identical uploads,
     passing 1 + 2 proves every Zenodo file; only one download needs to
     be exercised end to end.

     NOTE: intentionally duplicated in curatedCRCData. -->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(Biobase))
pkg <- params$package
stopifnot(requireNamespace(pkg))
```

# 1. Uploaded objects vs pre-refactor package objects

```{r compare-objects}
pre <- tempfile("pre-refactor-")
system2("git", c("worktree", "add", "--detach", pre, "pre-zenodo-refactor"),
        stdout = FALSE)

manifest <- read.csv(file.path("..", "extdata", "zenodo-manifest.csv"))
loadOne <- function(path) {
    env <- new.env(); nm <- load(path, envir = env); get(nm[1], envir = env)
}
cmp <- vapply(manifest$dataset, function(nm) {
    old <- loadOne(file.path(pre, "data", paste0(nm, ".rda")))
    new <- loadOne(file.path(params$upload_dir, paste0(nm, ".rda")))
    isTRUE(all.equal(exprs(old), exprs(new))) &&
        isTRUE(all.equal(pData(old), pData(new))) &&
        isTRUE(all.equal(fData(old), fData(new))) &&
        identical(annotation(old), annotation(new)) &&
        isTRUE(all.equal(experimentData(old), experimentData(new)))
}, logical(1))
system2("git", c("worktree", "remove", "--force", pre))
data.frame(dataset = manifest$dataset, identical = cmp)
stopifnot(all(cmp))
```

# 2. Manifest md5s vs local uploads and Zenodo

```{r compare-md5}
local_md5 <- tools::md5sum(file.path(params$upload_dir, manifest$filename))
stopifnot(identical(unname(local_md5), manifest$md5))

record <- unique(sub(".*records/([0-9A-Za-z_]+)/.*", "\\1", manifest$url))
stopifnot(length(record) == 1L)
api <- jsonlite::fromJSON(paste0("https://zenodo.org/api/records/", record))
zen <- data.frame(filename = api$files$key,
                  md5 = sub("^md5:", "", api$files$checksum))
merged <- merge(manifest[, c("filename", "md5")], zen, by = "filename",
                suffixes = c(".manifest", ".zenodo"))
stopifnot(nrow(merged) == nrow(manifest),
          identical(merged$md5.manifest, merged$md5.zenodo))
merged
```

# 3. Download smoke test

```{r smoke-test}
getter <- get(pkg, envir = asNamespace(pkg))
smallest <- manifest$dataset[which.min(manifest$size_bytes)]
# use a throwaway cache so the user's real package cache is untouched
old_cache <- Sys.getenv("R_USER_CACHE_DIR", unset = NA)
Sys.setenv(R_USER_CACHE_DIR = tempfile("cache-"))
eset <- getter(smallest)              # downloads
stopifnot(is(eset, "ExpressionSet"))
eset2 <- getter(smallest)             # must hit the cache silently
stopifnot(identical(dim(eset), dim(eset2)))
if (is.na(old_cache)) Sys.unsetenv("R_USER_CACHE_DIR") else
    Sys.setenv(R_USER_CACHE_DIR = old_cache)
dim(eset)
```
